##### Project general facts

La Mer by Elie Saab is an exclusive branded residential development on Al Marjan Island, offering a refined waterfront lifestyle shaped by couture-inspired design and architectural elegance. Comprising three distinctive towers, the project captures the essence of sophisticated coastal living, where bespoke interiors, serene surroundings, and panoramic views of the Arabian Gulf come together in perfect harmony. Every aspect of the development reflects Elie Saab’s signature aesthetic, blending timeless luxury with contemporary comfort in one of the region’s most prestigious island destinations.

Residents enjoy a tranquil and elevated lifestyle in a setting defined by beauty, privacy, and a strong connection to the shoreline. The development is designed to create a peaceful residential environment where expansive sea views, elegant communal spaces, and the natural calm of Al Marjan Island enhance everyday living. With its iconic design and exceptional location, La Mer by Elie Saab offers a unique retreat that balances exclusivity with the atmosphere of a luxury resort destination.

Each residence is finished to a high standard with interiors that combine rich textures, sophisticated detailing, and timeless design elements. Kitchens are equipped with built-in appliances, including a fridge, freezer, hob, oven, washing machine, and dishwasher by Siemens or equivalent brands, while penthouses and villas feature upgraded Miele or equivalent appliances. Bathrooms are fitted with premium sanitary ware by Geberit and Gessi, and the residences are delivered semi-furnished, offering an elegant and well-appointed foundation for luxury island living.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Marjan Island is a stunning man-made archipelago located in Ras Al Khaimah, UAE. Comprising four coral-shaped islands, this destination stretches over 4.5 kilometers into the Arabian Gulf, offering a blend of residential, hospitality, and leisure experiences. Known for its serene environment, pristine beaches, and crystal-clear waters, Al Marjan Island has become a sought-after destination for luxury living and vacationing, as well as a hub for investment in high-end properties and resorts.

The island is designed to offer a peaceful, resort-style lifestyle, making it an attractive retreat for both residents and tourists. With a mix of luxury hotels, resorts, waterfront homes, and marinas, Al Marjan Island is a perfect destination for those seeking a relaxing yet opulent living experience. The development is home to several high-profile hospitality brands, which complement the exclusive residential projects with premium services and facilities.

Al Marjan Island also benefits from its strategic location, just 30 minutes from Ras Al Khaimah International Airport, making it easily accessible for both international and local visitors. The island hosts various events and activities throughout the year, including wellness retreats and water sports, creating a vibrant, family-friendly atmosphere while preserving the tranquility and beauty of its natural surroundings.
